title: Algebra sheaves of tensor powers and their homogeneous quotient
statement: For a closed immersion j:Z→X [def-weil-closed-immersion] and an invertible O_X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module], there exist commutative O_X-algebra sheaves B,C [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], an algebra map p:B→C, homogeneous maps b_d:L^d→B and c_d:j_*j^*L^d→C, exhibiting their underlying module sheaves as coproducts. They satisfy b_d;p=eta_d;c_d for the chosen tensor-pullback unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and b_a(s)b_d(t)=b_(a+d)(tensorPowAddIso(a,d)^(-1)(s⊗t)) on every open. No kernel or degree projection data and no square-zero assumption are included.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and its direct sum; canonical construction before cohomology

proof.text: On a frame open for L construct polynomial algebra sheaves O_X[T] and j_*O_Z[T]. Glue by transition maps T↦uT; degree-d maps transform by u^d. The gluing yields B,C,p and the homogeneous inclusions, with their coproduct universal properties.

Compare the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction with the usual one by uniqueness of left adjoints. The units differ by an invertible natural transformation on j_*j^*. Precompose the target homogeneous inclusions by its inverse; coproduct universality is preserved and the quotient squares now use the chosen unit. Polynomial multiplication in B on every frame proves the homogeneous multiplication equation, which glues by separation. No multiplication compatibility is required of c.
